description: Federal Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) Commons is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Forest Service (USFS); National Institute of Standards and Technology | Metrics and Tools for Sustainable Buildings; USDA National Agricultural Library. Life Cycle Assessment evaluates the environmental impacts of a product or service throughout its entire life cycle, from raw material extraction to disposal. The LCA Commons is a central point of access to data repositories for use in Life Cycle Assessment. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page.  Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Energy and Utilities, Forestry, Transportation and Mobility. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
